title: My Best Fiend
description: Filmmaker Werner Herzog narrates an exploration of his love-hate relationship with actor Klaus Kinski.

title: The Wendell Baker Story
description: An amiable con artist (Luke Wilson) helps retirement-home residents fight back against a mean-spirited nurse (Owen Wilson) who steals their money and treats them like slaves.

title: Police Story
description: A kung-fu policeman must protect a female witness from a Hong Kong drug lord for whom she used to work.

title: Point Break
description: An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.

title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town.

title: Road Games
description: An Australian trucker (Stacy Keach) picks up a hitchhiking heiress (Jamie Lee Curtis) and the trail of a killer in a green van.

title: Hush
description: A deaf woman is stalked by a killer in her home.

title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
description: In the central story, Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) struggles with his inner demons and tries to maintain control until his former lover, Ava Lord (Eva Green), returns wanting his help to escape her abusive husband.

title: The Ron Clark Story
description: A small-town teacher (Matthew Perry) moves to New York and makes a difference in the lives of his students.

title: The BeastMaster
description: Prehistoric Darwin uses ESP with animals to save a slave girl from a sorcerer.

title: Boris Karloff: The Man Behind the Monster
description: A look at the career of Boris Karloff.

title: Stagecoach
description: An outlaw (John Wayne), a prostitute (Claire Trevor), a drunken doctor and assorted others go through Indian country.

title: Dawg
description: In order to inherit $1 million, a heartless womanizer (Denis Leary) must seek forgiveness from his former conquests.

title: Judgment Night
description: On their way to a boxing match, four young men take a wrong turn in Chicago and find danger as witnesses to murder.

title: Rendel: Dark Vengeance
description: Rendel, a masked superhero, becomes blinded by his desire for revenge against a sinister criminal organization.

title: Prospect
description: A man and his teenage daughter encounter nonstop danger while searching for valuable gems on an alien moon.

title: Luv
description: Accompanied by his young nephew (Michael Rainey Jr.), an ex-convict (Common) tries to raise money through a drug deal.

title: Nightbreed: Director's Cut
description: A young man's quest to end his nightmares leads him to a cemetery where monsters have retreated to escape mankind.

title: To Kill With Intrigue
description: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

title: The Little Shop of Horrors
description: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

title: Rock 'n' Roll High School
description: A teenager (P.J. Soles) and her friends get even with their principal to music by the Ramones.

title: Night of the Demons
description: Wild teenage girls (Mimi Kinkade, Linnea Quigley) hold a Halloween seance in an old funeral parlor to scare their friends.

title: The Compleat Al
description: A colorful reality marries an equally vivid imagination in a hilarious portrait of musician-satirist Alfred Matthew "Weird Al" Yankovic's personal life and career.

title: The Rookies
description: An extreme sports athlete joins a mysterious special agent and her ragtag team of recruits to battle a group of deadly terrorists.

title: Donnie Darko: The Director's Cut
description: An unusual teenager (Jake Gyllenhaal) follows the instructions of the 6-foot-tall rabbit which saved his life.

title: Saturn 3
description: A madman (Harvey Keitel) and his shiny robot chase a May-December couple (Farrah Fawcett, Kirk Douglas) doing food research on Saturn's third moon.

title: The Kill Room
description: A hit man teams up with an art dealer for a money-laundering scheme that unwittingly turns him into an avant-garde sensation.

title: Space Truckers
description: A freight pilot (Dennis Hopper), his girlfriend (Debi Mazar) and an apprentice (Stephen Dorff) try to deliver cargo to Earth in 2197.

title: Infernal Affairs III
description: Ten months after the murder of Yan, Ming is set to work on mundane office duties; Yeung reminds Ming of his own suspicious rise to fame.

title: Cobra Verde
description: A Brazilian plantation owner sends an employee (Klaus Kinski) to West Africa to re-establish a slave network.

title: Rolling Kansas
description: Three brothers, a gas-station attendant and a narcoleptic nurse embark on a road trip to find a marijuana forest.

title: Holy Motors
description: Driven around Paris by a loyal driver (Edith Scob), a mysterious man (Denis Lavant) dresses up in costumes and plays a number of strange, semiscripted roles.

title: Bloodfist II
description: The world kickboxing champion (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) retreats to Manila, lands in a mess and fights his way out.

title: Lazy Susan
description: Susan is a self-centered woman who lazily skates through life with the grudging support of her increasingly estranged family. Realizing she's middle-aged with no job and no relationship, Susan finally decides to take charge and turn things around.

title: Metroland
description: Urging a bohemian existence, a former schoolmate disrupts a London couple's conventional lifestyle.

title: Copshop
description: On the run from a lethal assassin, a wily con artist hides out inside a police station. When the hitman turns up at the precinct, a rookie cop finds herself caught in the crosshairs.

title: Masquerade
description: Eleven-year-old Casey is home alone -- until intruders break in to steal her family's priceless artworks. As the stakes grow higher, Casey now finds herself in a fight for her life as the invaders prove they'll stop at nothing to get what they want.

title: Bloodfist
description: A Los Angeles kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) trains with a master (Joe Marie Avellana) in Manila to avenge his brother in a tournament.

title: The Lady Vanishes
description: An heiress (Cybill Shepherd) and a photographer (Elliott Gould) are sure an English nanny (Angela Lansbury) was on their train in the Alps.

title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
description: King Arthur (Graham Chapman) goes questing on a pretend horse, followed by his lackey clacking coconut shells.

title: King Kong Lives
description: The big ape receives a heart transplant and runs off with his blood donor, a she-ape having his baby.

title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
description: Three investigators (Jean Reno, Benoît Magimel, Camille Natta) track a cloaked killer who possesses superhuman strength and speed.

title: Misbehaviour
description: A team of women hatches a plan to disrupt the 1970 Miss World beauty competition in London.
